notes.title: Baby Goat Billy is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Woooo hooooo!

It is with great privilege to announce that the complete version of Baby Goat Billy is now available for download!!! If that's all you need to know, get out there and starting playing! But for those who want to bask in the moment with us, please read on.

It's incredible to think back to when this all started nearly two years ago. The game entered Early Access on 4th of November with a strong and engaging core gameplay. Your feedback helped to ensure the correct prioritization of new features and upcoming content. Baby Goat Billy is more than a game to me. It started as a small idea but became a completely unique alternative world where goats rule the earth instead of humans. As I wrote the backstory and created the fantastical world I was entering into a fairytale about a heroic little goat trying to save his baby brother. 

It is a understatement to say that I have put all my love and heart into it!

[h3]CONTENT:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 3 Dungeons fully completed with increasing difficulty
[*] 12 new enemies
[*] 17 new cards
[*] 8 new talents
[*] 12 Blessings
[*] More challenging spikes and fire obstacles
[*] BOSS FIGHT!
[/list]

[h3][b]Dont forget to reset your previous data, otherwise it will mess up your dialogs and talents![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/db8262a14df4c0b10646e0fbf59cc6ac77f5cefc.gif[/img]

All I can say is thank you!

- Rumen Petrov

notes.title: Movement and feature improvements
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience! December and January have been a busy month for us all and with extra complications around holidays and COVID. You are now able to play the latest build and here are the updates:

[h2] [b]Grid movement - removed [/b][/h2] We now have a simple and [b]easy to use 3rd person camera + movement system.[/b] Many players have complained about this and we heard you, we hope you will traverse through the game world much smoother now!

[h2] [b]New Blessings Feature:[/b][/h2] You receive buffs which last for the duration of your dungeon run. It allows for more synergy in the combat. Each dungeon contains 2-3 blessing spots, and you can choose 1 of 2 blessings at each spot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/09d1e6a7b6acd19657a2c6743381144df779a83e.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Trance mechanic[/b][/h2]Trance is a state of halucination and when you play a card, another card is drawn into this slot. This mechanic gives you more choices and while in Trance you will never run out of cards. You gain stacks of Trance from blessings and cards and each turn you lose 1 stack of Trance. We will continue to add more blessings and cards that synergize with this mechanic.

- 10 new talents available
- New Barricade Card 
- New Pummel Card
- New Rebound Card
- Players can now spend gold on other things except cards at the tomb offering(shop).
- Green totem visuals fix
- Ritual Card description edited
- Recognition Card special cases work now
- Stun card adjustments
- Cards triggering rare bug fixed
- Rebalanced some Evil cards and enemies.


We are looking forward to bringing you more content and awesome gameplay throughout 2022!
Any questions, feedback, suggestions or just wanna get in touch?

notes.title: Patch notes 19 November
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, time for another update once again!

[b][h3]From now on, 90% of my time will be focused on the new dungeon. There will be 9 new enemies, more cards, 4 new rooms to explore and much more challenging movement obstacles. Please be patient as it will take some time :)[/h3][/b]
Thanks to all the players and streamers providing feedback and helping me improve the experience.
I would love to hear your feedback/suggestions on [b]DISCORD[/b]: discord.gg/bbwKnRXEwy

Here is a list of things I have been working on in the last week:

- Fixed a [b]serious issue[/b] where cards didn't want to load resulting in a empty Pick a reward screen. Took me 2-3 days to figure out how to solve it but now it works flawlessly. Saving player progress is tricky...
- [b]6 new cards available: [/b] Recognition, Sacrifice, Ritual, Halt, Acupuncture, Needle (I tried to test them, so there shouldnt be any bugs)
- All [b]Ethereal[/b] cards now have the word[b] EXHAUST[/b] instead. Players suggested its easier to understand and standartized in other similar games.
- Fixed: Enemies that attack first turn would show incorrect damage amount, from previous enemy.
- Mushrooms quest is now more visible to new players and added some more explanation so that players know what they are supposed to do. Totems are a really fun mechanic and cool part of the game, i didnt want new players to miss out on that!
- New leveling up UI animation, several people mentioned that it would be nice if Leveling up is more "in your face" hahaha I hope you like the improvement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/cd2fee93c1092e212fba79d9541cba6f5479846f.png[/img]

- Your character now reacts when you click on him in the main screen with the castle in the background(as requested by streamers)
- Obstacles damage label now always faces the camera
- Now the character stops when in dialog to avoid bugs.
- fixed: shop gets closed now when you open the deck screen to avoid confusion
- fixed: player dies now at 0 hp from obstacles or leaving battle.
- fixed: replace hand card was ending battle if 0 mana
- fixed: Ethereal descriptions are now consistent
- fixed: Weaken now unlocks correctly
- Added some more clarification to movement and camera controls
- More description to Parasite cards.
- Golems can now do "Nothing" only once in a row.
- Enraged villager actions pattern adjusted.

notes.title: July - Game Update
notes.notes:
Once again, its time to share some insights from the development. During Early Access we will make more effort of being transparent and showing what is happening with the game more often, but currently we try to update you only when there are big/important changes.

Since the last update there has been a ton of new content added to the game, while also improving the beginning and core mechanics of Baby Goat Billy.

The game has now 2 dungeons COMPLETELY FINISHED! YAAAAYYY! ːsteamhappyː

First dungeon allows players to get used to the game, combat mechanics and how to build strategy with their decks. It is relatively easy and should take between 1-3 attempts to complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/91988189cd99adcde989dce0b698e90856f12d14.gif[/img]

The second dungeon "DREADFUL PATH OF FIRE" ramps up the difficulty as it introduces new enemies with a bit trickier abilities and lets not forget, SPIKES AND FIRE OBSTACLES!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/6c4048e52c23ffb674f0ac26e816875fe1efd81c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/de9d37187daec3e105c9bec4530c5634aef5cd95.png[/img]

So far, the game has about 2-6 hours of content which is full of unique experiences, art, story and gameplay mechanics.

BETA PLAYTEST: 
During August, we have organized a private playtest in which players will be providing us with feedback, filling out surveys and helping us polish the experience. During September there should be a lot of improvements and hopefully the game will be ready for its Early Access release <3 

Here is a list of some cool stuff we have implemented already:
[list]
[*] Battle encounters improved
[*] More Monoliths backstory about the world
[*] 2 New Totems
[*] Saving progress system
[*] 6 New Talents
[*] Shaman NPC character implementation
[*] 12 New Cards
[*] Less randomness in enemy actions(player requested)
[*] "DREADFUL PATH OF FIRE" second dungeon unlocked!
[*] 4 New enemies in the second dungeon.
[*] Added a bunch of Sound effects.
[*] Added and improved Visual effects and particles for combat and dungeons.
[*] More character animations for the main protagonist.
[*] Some action cameras for the battle
[*] Significant improvement in main character movement and animation transitions
[*] Significant outside of battle camera improvements
[/list]

We are working on even more exciting things, but they will remain a secret for now... expect big updates in the upcoming months!

notes.title: Dreadful path of Fire - New Dungeon and survey results!
notes.notes:
This update is a mix of new content added to the game and some reworks of the core mechanics.

During this last month I have had several playtesting sessions which resulted in 30 unique users filling out my survey, providing feedback, suggestions and helping me understand what they want to see in the game next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/5dd3443dd8817d7873dce436790319e45e99f131.png[/img]

The conclusive opinions of people have been positive, which motivates me to keep improving the game. 
There are still some connections between systems to flesh out and I am actively thinking of ways to make everything more coherent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/50ca4b21ab61429559acd4877c16b191d81d7160.png[/img]

At this early stage, even with rather few cards and status effects the combat has still earned itself an average of 7/10 amongst players, which I hope I can push to 8-9 in the future as I keep on adding more cards, totems, more surprising enemies and intricate strategies.
Hopefully at some stage I can add more eye candy with exciting visuals/VFX and animations to make the combat even cooler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/ea25241b5f92787089bbdcab43273c6620389e2e.png[/img]
Different people like it for different reasons but the visuals, theme and story have been a favorite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/0e41f55a4e5f48745f5b5289c2784ef25caf46c1.png[/img]
Several people have mentioned that they would like more variety in the combat/status effects and more strategy options. I'm happy to say that naturally as the game keeps growing, there will be many more viable strategies to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/6c1f876a28cbba54fee35a109d97d79599260be2.png[/img]
There are definitely still some rough areas, like animations, text, camera that still need tweaking but I have to prioritize more important features, so hopefully I will come back to those in the future :) 

List of Updates:
- Battle encounters now happen predominantly in DANGER ZONES. 
- HP numbers visible
- Next attack damage numbers now visible
- Weaken cards now affect next damage numbers
- More story about the dungeon and the world narrated through the Monoliths
- New green totem
- Added some talents and reworked old ones.
- Quick Adapt and Hard block rebalanced
- Applied feedback from player survey
- Background music
- Market improved flow
- Eagle enemy - new animations and added ui elements for its skills
- Skull enemy - rebalanced attack patterns
- Gold icon
- New 3D bird enemy in progress
- Added new enemies to the second dungeon "DREADFUL PATH OF FIRE"
- You can make an offering at the tombs and exchange gold for cards.
- Player damage label fixed location and has multiple labels to manage fast consecutive attacks.
- Map camera adjustments
- Obstacle zone does not trigger battles.
- Visual elements and tooltip descriptions fixed.
- Added dmg build up to the masked goat enemy.

Next tasks:
- Adding more backstory of the world/evil tribe/dungeons.
- Adding and polishing talents
- Adding more cards
- New side quests and puzzles
- Polishing the victory screen
- Developing more ideas how to connect the different gameplay elements better

Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Complete UI/UX overhaul, new mechanics and lots of onboarding improvements
notes.notes:
Over this last month I have put extra effort to put the game in the hands of youtubers, streamers and gamers to understand how they play and what are the things they dont like. I have received a lot of super valuable feedback, but I am extremely happy to say that their feedback has confirmed my existing to-do list and my future plan matches with their expectations. 

[b]1. User interface[/b]
Lots of players complained about UI and UX issues, I have worked for several weeks to make everything as smooth as possible. Its not perfect but 100 times better than before. It also looks nicer :P 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/09d3efef892aaf50960082ad42bc6360b9bdf0a3.png[/img]

[b]2. New combat mechanic - TOTEMS[/b]
Totems are additional feature which the player can discover and use them in combination with the cards, they get triggered upon specific actions and can stack up great damage and be an invaluable part of your deck strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/7150bde65fd8cb9fdce3f460bd33f4f07df9198f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/91988189cd99adcde989dce0b698e90856f12d14.gif[/img]

[b]3. I have added about 10 new cards,[/b] currently there are about 3-4 different strategy builds. But im not in a rush to create many. I want to make sure the core loop is entertaining and then move on to adding more content.

[b]4. Extra side activities [/b]
The new side activities were much needed breakup of the combat/combat/combat loop. To break up the constant battles I have added herbs and ingredients collection system, a few side quests and dialogs and im working on a new level with obstacles which I will probably reveal in the next update.

[b]5. After receiving so much feedback [/b]and seeing how streamers play the game, I worked on a lot of UI/UX improvements, explaining better some status effects, adding hints and new icons to give context to the player.

[b]6. Added the Monolith stories.[/b]
Monolith stories are an opportunity for the player to find out more of the world through story. They will give more context about the village, the dungeons and what events happened before the current situation. Perhaps it could be interesting to share some bits of story here in the future...

[b]7. Shop for cards[/b]
I started working on a shop in which you can choose your favorite cards and purchase them with gold, collected from dungeons and battles. I think this will help the player explore new decks and rely less on random luck when finding cards.

[b]8. I also worked for a few days trying to improve the User interface [/b]adaptability for diffferent resolutions. Now it works well with 16:10, 4:3, 4:5 etc. After all not everyone has Full HD or 4k monitors :) 

Thank you very much for reading, I am working full time on this game and hope to go into early access in a few months. I am excited to share it with new players and release updates based on your reception.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39156371/56f4c2940cb1067c9ffd1c3a335c7c9bc14754e7.png[/img]

notes.title: Content update! More goats, more battles, more deckbuilding
notes.notes:
More challenging encounters await you in the dungeon, are you sure you brought your best deck with you? If not, its okay, you can try combining different cards and discover which strategies work best against which enemies. But beware, your baby brother is still out there.... time is precious....
[/i]
[b]BGB (Baby Goat Billy)[/b] is still at an early stage and I want to make sure that the combat is solid, before committing to creating 100+ cards. I want to explore what players enjoy and what is the right balance of complexity and difficulty. I still don't even know what my target audience is... If you think you are the right audience, reach out on [url=https://twitter.com/home?lang=en]Twitter [/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/BabyGoatBilly]FB[/url], Steam or any other platform. Help me deliver the most exciting experience for you! Also the more people Wishlist the game, the more sure I will be that there is an audience at all.

[h2]This update includes...[/h2]

[b]1. Talent tree[/b] - There are 4 different talent families, each talent brings you a small bonus/improvement but also unlocks cards and this is how you pick your deckbuilding strategy. There will be multiple playstyles available for players to explore:
[list]
[*] [b]Wrath:[/b] - Focusing on brutal force and direct damage, but this simple strategy might not work against some powerful enemies.
[*] [b]Wisdom[/b] - Focusing on more defensive playstyle with lots of armor, healing and using your armor to inflict damage;
[*] [b]Holy [/b] - Perhaps using buffs and blessings is your strategy of choice, you can use those to increase your critical chance, avoiding attacks or regenerating;
[*] [b]Evil [/b] - Do you like cursing your enemies with negative effects and stacking weakening spells on them? Perhaps this path can intrigue you!
[/list]
[b]2. New starting area with several new characters and dialogs.[/b] BGB is not just a deck-builder, but also a story-driven adventure, in the new village area you will find interesting characters, dialogs and as you progress you will discover more and more about the world and what has happened to your brother. You are just a young goat, you have a lot to discover and learn...
[b]3. New cinematics and cutscenes.
4. New enemies with new mechanics and status effects.
5. New cards to build stronger decks
6. Two new levels
7. Usability improvements[/b] (based on player feedback)
[b]8. Movement and collision improvements [/b](based on player feedback)
[b]9. Sound settings[/b] (based on streamers feedback)

[h2]
Next steps...
[/h2]
[olist]
[*] New combat mechanic that will freshen the battles and is quite innovative to the genre. It will allow deeper strategy and deck-building synergies.
[*] Improvements on UI and UX. (based on player feedback)
[*] Victory screen animation.
[*] More cards and enemies. (based on player feedback)
[/olist]
